title: Law to require more businesses to separate food waste
summary: This bill would broaden the categories of businesses that the Department of Sanitation can require to separate and properly dispose of organic waste, removing prior size and seating thresholds for stores, restaurants, arenas and other establishments. The Department of Sanitation would have to designate additional covered establishments by December 1, 2026, with compliance required by June 1, 2027 or when the business's commercial waste zone takes effect. Waste carters would also have to inform newly covered establishments about donating excess edible food.
